title: Irremeable
summary: IRRE'MEABLE, adjective [Latin irremeabilis; in and remeo, to return; re and meo, to pass.] Admitting no return; as an irremeable way.

inlines.v: IRRE'MEABLE, adjective [Latin irremeabilis; in and remeo, to return; re and meo, to pass.] Admitting no return; as an irremeable way.
